segments.name: Bell CTS Canada
segments.description: Provides wireless and wireline communication products and services to consumer, business and government customers across Canada.
segments.evidence: Our Bell CTS Canada segment provides a wide range of communication products and services to consumer, business and government customers across Canada.

segments.name: Bell CTS U.S.
segments.description: Comprised of Ziply Fiber, provides wireline communication products and services to residential, business and wholesale customers in the Pacific Northwest U.S.
segments.evidence: Our Bell CTS U.S. segment, comprised of Ziply Fiber, provides wireline communication products and services over a combined fibre-based and copper-based network, to residential, business and wholesale customers in the Pacific Northwest of the U.S.

segments.name: Bell Media
segments.description: Holds a portfolio of media assets providing video, audio, out-of-home advertising and digital media services to customers across Canada.
segments.evidence: Our Bell Media segment holds a portfolio of assets providing premium video, audio, OOH advertising, and digital media services to customers nationally across Canada.
